title.narrative: Strengthening National Efforts

description.narrative: This project will strengthen national capacities to identify and provide tailored assistance on identifying potential victims of trafficking in the Republic of Moldova and ensuring that long-term reintegration options are consolidated and expanded to facilitate safe, dignified, and productive reintegration into society. IOM will provide sub-grants to local NGOs to implement prevention and protection activities. The project aims to improve comprehensive services for human trafficking victims by supporting the Government of Moldova and civil society efforts to ensure that trafficking victims are included in assistance programs and by piloting reintegration services for male victims of trafficking. The project will also strengthen the existing legal framework and improve victim identification and assistance by consolidating state standards on provision of reintegration services. The project also will raise awareness of human trafficking and risk factors through a nationwide promotion of a trafficking in persons hotline.
